### 1. Scene
A small mixed-leaf salad with strawberries, blueberries, blackberries, and a light, glossy dressing.

### 2. Vessel
A large, roughly square dinner plate, approximately **26 cm across**. Using a 26 cm circular equivalent for the area calculation:  
**3.14 × 13² ≈ 531 cm²**. Plate shape and cropped edges introduce uncertainty.

### 3. Items
Spinach and mixed salad leaves; sliced strawberries; blueberries; blackberries; visible dressing, estimated as oil-based.

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight, and energy
Food occupies approximately **51%** of the plate. Areas below partition the visible food footprint; dressing overlaps the other ingredients.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Mixed leaves and spinach | 36% | 191 cm² × 2.3 cm = 439 ml | 0.15 | 66 g | 23 | 15 |
| Strawberries | 11% | 58 cm² × 1.5 cm = 87 ml | 0.60 | 52 g | 32 | 17 |
| Blueberries | 2% | 11 cm² × 1 cm = 11 ml | 0.60 | 7 g | 57 | 4 |
| Blackberries | 2% | 11 cm² × 1.5 cm = 16 ml | 0.60 | 10 g | 43 | 4 |
| Oil-based dressing | 0% additional; overlapping | 60 cm² × 0.1 cm = 6 ml | 1.0 | 6 g | 700 | 42 |

### 8. Sanity check
**Approximately 141 g and 82 kcal** is plausible for this airy salad with a modest quantity of berries. The dressing is the largest source of energy uncertainty.
